verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers only FIDO2/U2F use for Google/web sign-in, Bluetooth pairing, NFC, and physical hardware details — there is no mention of sk-ssh, PIV, OpenPGP, or any SSH-key hardware-backing capability. missing for 10: sk-ssh/FIDO2 SSH key support, PIV applet, OpenPGP applet, any developer SSH workflow documentation.
